description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Zagoth Triome, adding {G}.
Activate Floral Evoker by paying {G} and discarding Veilborn Ghoul, returning Zagoth Triome from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Zagoth Triome enters, Floral Evoker and Veilborn Ghoul trigger.
Resolve the Floral Evoker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Veilborn Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
